dedupe_keys.name: urban flood modeling and forecasting with deep neural operator

description: The UrbanFloodCast researchers publish a benchmark for fast urban flood forecasting in two Berlin areas. Zenodo supplies a dataset archive under CC BY 4.0. The own page says each area was simulated under 125 design-storm rainfall events; the public code repository describes separate training, validation and test partitions, including unseen rainfall distributions and downscaling cases. Deep neural operator and transfer-learning implementations are hosted in that repository, not represented by this Zenodo data file alone. These scenarios can benchmark surrogate flood models before they are used for road or building exposure simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Berlin benchmark. Coverage is two modelled urban areas and synthetic storms, not actual measurements of every Berlin flood. A limitation is that surrogate accuracy depends on the original simulator and train-test split; transfer outside Berlin remains unverified. The dataset ZIP was not downloaded and no forecast score was reproduced.
